ValidationRule.description: Not allow Comments field to be updated if logged in user is not DA
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.NSP_AssetValidations__c!=True, ISCHANGED(NSP_Pending_Report_Comments__c), $UserRole.DeveloperName !='District_Administrator', NOT(OR( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator" , $Profile.Name = "Data Migration", $Profile.Name = "Sales Administrator", $Profile.Name = "Integration User")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You don't have permission to update comments on asset.
